title: aidd record export --format json
description: Gate records or gate events, each exactly once and in a stable order, for a tool that cannot read JSON lines. A new optional key may be added in a minor release; a renamed or removed key bumps `schema_version`.

schema_version.description: The version of this output's shape.

kind.description: What the items are: gate records (record.schema.json) or gate events (event.schema.json).

items.description: Each record or event as it was written: records by change and head, events by time, then repository, change, and head.
